title: What to Do When You Can’t Quit Your Job Yet
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: CONSTRAINT, from the Attachment B spec. The distinction the whole video runs on.
teaching_assets.trigger: They are not the same thing.
teaching_assets.onscreen: I CANNOT LEAVE YET: a constraint / NOTHING CAN CHANGE: a conclusion
teaching_assets.purpose: The reframe the entire video depends on, in the hook.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column alone for 2.0s. Right column on the second sentence. Headline last.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The two labels, constraint and conclusion.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the no-second-full-time-job line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft accent as the conclusion column arrives.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New. The script puts safety before the career exercise and the Attachment B set had no dedicated frame for it.
teaching_assets.trigger: This is not a request to tolerate an unsafe or harmful situation.
teaching_assets.purpose: Places the safety boundary where the script places it, before any planning.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Headline alone for 1.8s. Support line at 2.4s.
teaching_assets.hold: 8 to 9 seconds. The support line must be readable.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the cannot-interpret line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none. This must not feel dramatic.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: This video does not interpret an employment agreement, benefits arrangement, immigration rules or a health decision. Do not let the frame imply otherwise.

teaching_assets.trigger: You need to protect what must hold, put boundaries where you can, and prepare one possible next step.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PROTECT WHAT MUST HOLD / BOUND WHAT YOU CAN / PREPARE ONE POSSIBLE NEXT STEP
teaching_assets.purpose: The hero framework. Returns briefly at each section change.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One line at a time, 0.9s apart. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 10 seconds first time, 3 seconds on each return.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent per line, then a resolve. Or one resolve only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PROTECT, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own sentence stem.
teaching_assets.onscreen: FOR NOW, ANY CHANGE NEEDS TO PROTECT...
teaching_assets.purpose: The first deliverable. One sentence the viewer writes down.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Stem alone for 2.0s. Support line at 2.6s.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 10 seconds. The viewer is writing.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the second step.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft accent on the stem.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: You do not have to justify the answer to strangers. The pinned comment must not ask viewers to disclose it.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PRIORITY, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own two versions.
teaching_assets.onscreen: THE FEELING: this job is impossible / THE SPECIFIC ASK: what should change in priority, scope, support, or timing?
teaching_assets.purpose: Gives the viewer a sentence to use, with the safety caveat attached to the same frame.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column 1.8s, right column on the reframe, caveat at 4.0s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The right column, then the caveat.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. The right column is a long sentence.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the no-room-to-negotiate passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft click as the specific ask arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Not a guarantee of a reasonable response, and not advice to refuse work in a way that could put someone at risk. The caveat stays on the frame.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PREPARE, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own comparison.
teaching_assets.trigger: Choose a question before you choose an activity.
teaching_assets.onscreen: AN ACTIVITY WITHOUT A TEST vs A QUESTION
teaching_assets.purpose: Stops the viewer converting a constraint into busywork.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Activity first, 1.6s. Question on the reframe. Closing line at 3.8s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the exchange-not-add passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as the question arrives.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: FOUR_LINES, from the Attachment B spec. The deliverable.
teaching_assets.trigger: Put four lines on a page:
teaching_assets.onscreen: What must hold for now? / What can I influence safely? / What one question would make the next option clearer? / When will I review this again?
teaching_assets.purpose: The private plan. The viewer will screenshot this.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One line at a time, 1.1s apart. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The fourth line. The review point is what makes for now real.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 13 seconds. This is the screenshot frame.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the limited-capacity passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent when the set completes.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: If capacity is extremely limited, the script says take only the first line and the review point. Do not let the frame imply all four are mandatory.

teaching_assets.trigger: The free Career Decision Evidence Check is linked below.
teaching_assets.onscreen: FREE CAREER DECISION EVIDENCE CHECK / temidayoafonja.com/career-decisions
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the closing line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The support line is the script's own limit. Keep it.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual.
teaching_assets.trigger: Watch “A 30-Day Plan to Test Your Next Career Move” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: A 30-DAY PLAN TO TEST YOUR NEXT CAREER MOVE
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Right of frame kept clear for the end-screen element.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. Final visual. No camera return, no outro.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural music fade.
